initialExam.title: UPTET 2026 (UP Teacher Eligibility Test)
initialExam.description: UP Teacher Eligibility Test for recruitment of primary (Class 1-5) and upper primary (Class 6-8) teachers in Uttar Pradesh government schools.
initialExam.qualifications: Diploma/Degree in Elementary Education or B.Ed
initialExam.syllabus: Paper I (Primary): Child Development, Language I (Hindi), Language II (English/Urdu/Sanskrit), Mathematics, Environmental Studies. Paper II (Upper Primary): Child Development, Language I, Language II, Math/Science or Social Studies.
initialExam.examPattern: Paper I: 150 questions, 150 marks, 2.5 hours. Paper II: 150 questions, 150 marks, 2.5 hours. No negative marking.
initialExam.selectionProcess: UPTET Qualification → Merit-based recruitment by UP Basic Education Board
initialExam.jobRole: Primary Teacher (PRT) and Upper Primary Teacher (TGT) in UP government schools
initialExam.careerGrowth: Assistant Teacher → Head Teacher → Block Education Officer.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit updeled.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, Pension, School accommodation in rural areas
